body.p: This listing of claims replaces all prior versions, and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Original) A handle trigger control apparatus, comprising a trigger bracket, wherein the handle trigger control apparatus further comprises:
a trigger (1) that is movably disposed on the trigger bracket and is provided thereon with a trigger magnet (3);
a bracket magnet (2) that is movable and can be fixedly provided on the trigger bracket; and
a control device configured to control the bracket magnet (2) to approach or go away from the trigger magnet (3) to adjust an action distance between the trigger magnet (3) and the bracket magnet (2).
2. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the bracket magnet (2) is directly opposite to the trigger magnet (3) that is in a fully pressed state, and a facing area of the bracket magnet (2) and the trigger magnet (3) that is in the fully pressed state remains unchanged when the control device controls the bracket magnet (2) to approach or go away from the trigger magnet (3).
3. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 2, wherein magnetic poles of opposite sides of the bracket magnet (2) and the trigger magnet (3) are same, and the bracket magnet (2) is located in a moving direction of pressing the trigger magnet (3).
4. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the trigger (1) is provided thereon with a groove, and the trigger magnet (3) is disposed in the groove.
5. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the trigger (1) is connected with the trigger bracket via an elastic member, and the elastic member is configured to drive the trigger in the pressed state to return its Original position.
6. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 5, wherein the elastic member is a position restoring spring, one end of the position restoring spring is connected with the trigger bracket, and the other end of the position restoring spring is connected with the trigger.
7. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 5, wherein the trigger (1) is hinged to the trigger bracket via a hinge shaft.
8. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 1, wherein an area of the trigger magnet (3) is same as that of the bracket magnet (1).
9. (Original) The handle trigger control apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the control device is provided with a signal receiving device configured to receive an adjustment command for the bracket magnet (2); or
the control device is preset with an adjustment command for the bracket magnet (2) in advance.
10. (Currently Amended) A handle comprises a handle trigger control apparatus according to any one of claims 1 9claim 1.
11. (New) The handle according to claim 10, wherein the bracket magnet (2) is directly opposite to the trigger magnet (3) that is in a fully pressed state, and a facing area of the bracket magnet (2) and the trigger magnet (3) that is in the fully pressed state remains unchanged when the control device controls the bracket magnet (2) to approach or go away from the trigger magnet (3).
12. (New) The handle according to claim 11, wherein magnetic poles of opposite sides of the bracket magnet (2) and the trigger magnet (3) are same, and the bracket magnet (2) is located in a moving direction of pressing the trigger magnet (3).
13. (New) The handle according to claim 10, wherein the trigger (1) is provided thereon with a groove, and the trigger magnet (3) is disposed in the groove.
14. (New) The handle according to claim 10, wherein the trigger (1) is connected with the trigger bracket via an elastic member, and the elastic member is configured to drive the trigger in the pressed state to return its Original position.
15. (New) The handle according to claim 14, wherein the elastic member is a position restoring spring, one end of the position restoring spring is connected with the trigger bracket, and the other end of the position restoring spring is connected with the trigger.
16. (New) The handle according to claim 14, wherein the trigger (1) is hinged to the trigger bracket via a hinge shaft.
17. (New) The handle according to claim 10, wherein an area of the trigger magnet (3) is same as that of the bracket magnet (1).
18. (New) The handle according to claim 10, wherein the control device is provided with a signal receiving device configured to receive an adjustment command for the bracket magnet (2); or
the control device is preset with an adjustment command for the bracket magnet (2) in advance.
